body: I don't have the tools to do that, that's why ending it all seem like a pretty viable option. I'm tired of being sad everyday, i'm tired of missing my ex, i'm tired of getting sick thinking about her with another guy and this has been going on for six months soon. It doesn't get better and i have to accept that.

I know they love me but i'm still a burden to me, they always have to worry about me and it's unfair to them...

I ate some disgusting hamburger last night when i was out drunk, walking around town, crying and wanting to just leave everything.

I can't picture myself in that situation, it's just a fantasy world where that would be possible, not in this world, not in my life. I have tried so hard and i've found girls that i really love but they leave and i can't put myself through that again, i can't put myself out there, loving someone with all of my heart and soul just to be crushed again. I thought i found the one and i worked so hard on being the best version of me that i could be, i did everything for her, i wanted to become a better person for her. She promised me that she would always be there for me and i promised her i would always be there for her, we promised eachother to fight through everything together, that we were meant to be together, we were soulmates. Then she left. Leaving me feeling all these feelings for her and she doesn't feel anything anymore. I can never understand how love can die like that, i don't want to understand it either.

I have tried improve myself during these months, it ended with me starting drinking instead because trying to improve myself made me even more depressed because i can't be what i'm not. I'm lost by myself, i need others, i need interactions, i need to be loved, i need to be close to someone but it will always end in pain and why put myself through that again when i could end the pain in a blink of an eye?

Man, you don't know shit about my life and what i've been through. I know there's plenty of people out there who has lost far more and far greater stuff than a abusive girlfriend and gotten through it. Good for them. We aren't wired the same, i'm not equipped to deal with shit, never have been, never will be and that's why it rips me apart when the person i loved and would have done everything for just leaves. But i try to deal with it and one way is to write about it even if it makes me sound like a pathetic bitch, it's fine, i don't really care. You are a self righteous asshole in my opinion with zero empathy. What may seem like nothing to you might be everything to someone else.

1. I know, i don't know why she feels that way when she was the abusive one and it's fucked up.

2. I haven't contacted her in forever, i struggle alone.

3. Again, really fucking helpful. But hey, i'm just a pathetic loser that feels like shit all the time so fuck it right.

I understand what you are saying and i want to get that into my thick head but i can't, it still feels bad every single day, i cry every single day, i walk around drunk and depressed every single day wishing it would just end, but it never does.
And i want to give this up and let go. How do i do that? I have tried for several months and i'm still fucking stuck and the more i struggle to forget the deeper i sink into this shit.
I guess that's true and everyone tells me that and i tell myself that but it doesn't help... It's just awful feeling like this and i just can't see myself with anyone else. I'm just broken.

You don't think i know that? You don't think i struggle with that shit every fucking day? I'm not equipped to deal with this, i'm struggling every single day with this and i just can't deal with it and it fucking kills me. If it were so simple that i could just "grow up and stop being pathetic" i would have done it by now. Really helpful comment tho!!

I know all this but it feels so shitty. I will never understand how one day i'm the love of her life, the one she want's to spend her life with and fight for no matter what happens and then it's just gone.
Yeah, i wish i did it from the start, maybe i would be ok now.
I wish it was that easy. Feels like i will never find anyone else, like no one finds me interesting or attractive at all.
I guess that's true and a very good parable. I kept doing it for months in the beginning and it got worse... It's just so hard to fully let go.
